name: Cash Ahead
office_task: Every Monday, publish our 13-week cash forecast from the open invoices, bills and payroll, with the assumption behind every line written down, and say so when a line cannot be read.
systems_of_record: the ledger (Xero or MYOB): open sales invoices, open bills and the operating bank balance
the payroll system (Xero Payroll, KeyPay or Employment Hero): the pay calendar and the last finalised pay run
the system the forecast is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the week's 13-week cash forecast per audience (owner, lender): the opening bank balance and receipts, bill payments and payroll for each of the next thirteen weeks, each line carrying its definition id (which names its assumption), source and as-of time, or published as unavailable with the reason; a correction is a new version superseding the old, with the named person and the reason
emits.readback: reading the week's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the line's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, a line with no definition (no named assumption) or two, a threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the week, the line, the reason and the exception_owner
